subject: Round-2 spec review: FAIL (3 blocking)
body: Re-reviewed the revised worker-contract spec with /sc:spec-panel-diffgate round 2 (skill loaded, read-only status and check --dry-run, which accepted the report with verdict FAIL), checked all 13 round-1 findings against the spec text and 17 changed citations against live files and Orca 1.4.245 help. Six of seven blocking round-1 findings are resolved, but R1.3 stays open because an Orca --retry-of attempt must reuse the failed Task and no verb changes a Task's brief, so a retry still overwrites attempt 1's --report-dir; two new blocking findings: AC-1.2 passes --output to workflow and runs the contract check on /sc:load (R2.1), and 7.2 step 3 needs worker_status that no P0 command writes while AC-0.4 requires it (R2.2), plus 3 minor notes (SA-2 wording vs ccsession-tag, parse-rule overclaim, CAPS:58 wrong line). Left for the coordinator: run the binding diffgate check (not dry run) to append close-r2.md, then one more fix cycle before the final review 3.
